summary: A process ADR that is implementable as policy; its only gap is that other ADRs cite slices, a reporting slice and a reporting KB that ADR 0021 no longer defines.

questions.text: ADRs 0025, 0007, 0008 and 0006 cite numbered slices, a reporting slice and a synthetic reporting KB defined in ADR 0021, but ADR 0021 defines none and says ordering belongs in issues.
questions.reason: Implementers cannot tell which proofs gate which slice; 0021 'implementation ordering belongs in issues, not a permanent roadmap' vs 0025 'spans implementation slices 3–4 in ADR 0021' and 0007 'ADR 0021's reporting slice includes a typed KB tool'.
